data.long_meaning: In various religious and spiritual traditions, the name Wash holds symbolism for cleansing, purification, and renewal. In Christianity, the name is reminiscent of baptism, the sacred ritual of washing away sins and reborn into a new life. The name Wash carries the meaning “Cleansing, purification” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wash usually hope their child will grow to embody cleansing, purification and live with faith, good character and purpose.
